environment.description: Bare-metal Debian 12 server running the Actix-web service as user 'appuser' (uid 1000). The /tmp directory is a standard ext4 filesystem mount with default permissions (1777). Multiple user accounts exist on the system. No mandatory access control (AppArmor/SELinux disabled). The service is behind a plain nginx reverse proxy with no content filtering. Container runtime: none (direct systemd service).

config.users: multiple local users with shell access
